scenarios.name: setup-vitest-with-coverage
scenarios.rationale: Response A covers most rubric items but lacks the required test:watch script and npx vitest command, while Response B uses the wrong coverage provider, omits the specific lines threshold, and also misses the npx command.

scenarios.name: mock-email-module-with-vi-mock
scenarios.rationale: Response A correctly mocks sendEmail with a resolved promise and includes a test, but misses the call assertion and hoisting; Response B asserts the call but uses the wrong module path, mock value, and still imports before the mock, making it slightly less compliant.

scenarios.name: configure-multiple-projects-dom-node
scenarios.rationale: Response A fully satisfies all rubric requirements, while Response B omits the dom project, its include pattern, and the specific command to run only DOM tests.
